visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product details accordion (features, specifications, finishes, mounting options, downloads), all items collapsed on load
visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-width rows separated by thin grey rules; small bold letter-spaced titles with a blue + toggle at the right; open item body on light grey

contentPattern.structure: One row per item. cell 1: title (plain text); cell 2: content (paragraphs, bold sub-heads or headings, bulleted lists, PDF/video links). Any number of rows; a single-cell row continues the previous item's content

usage: Long product reference content (features, specs, finishes, mounting/arm options, downloads) on product detail pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for collapsible product reference sections. Keep each item's content in one cell; use headings or bold paragraphs for sub-groups.
